notes.title: V3.0.20 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We've got a new update coming your way!
The main contents of this update are as follows (October 15th):
1. New language added into the game: Polish is available now.
2. Corrected the description for Ivan's [Aid] Level 1 skill in story mode.
3. Adjusted the refresh locations for the quests 'The Great Human Transformation' and 'Revisiting Greenvine' in Free Mode.
4. Fixed the issue where cards with the same name couldn’t be smelted (if you've run into this, feel free to reach out to us for help).
5. Fixed the issue where after reaching level 20, [Tępa Podkowa] would replace the selectable relic.
6. Added new side quests in Free Mode for 'Semir', 'Leo', 'Gloria', 'Quintina', 'Shire', 'Rena', 'Modima', 'Anonymous', 'Frend', and 'Mayall'.
7. Added new promotion quests in Free Mode for 'Sayerinne', 'Kena', 'Shire', and 'Delia'.

Huge thanks to our translators for their fantastic support in our Polish localization:

notes.title: Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross - Patch 3 Update Announcement (V1.0.04)
notes.notes:
Hi Fellows!

Please find the main updates contents as below: (11pm (GMT+8), 1th August))

I. New Additions

1.Introduction of Teammates' Exclusive Store
The Exclusive Store will provide sales of exclusive teammate cards and holy relics that have been unlocked via storyline achievements.

2.Addition of the Sacred Relic Backpack
Click the top left button on the main map to enter the Sacred Relic Backpack. You are free to select the active Sacred Relics, and all the obtained Sacred Relics will always remain in the Sacred Relic Backpack.

3. Addition of Level-Up Tasks
You can now participate in the new level-up tasks at the Camp - Trial Site. Select these tasks to gain gold coins and experience.

4. Addition of a New Teammate Recall Function
Head over to the Camp - Recruitment Site to access the teammate recall function. Here, you can recall former teammates without spending any gold coins.

5. Addition of Teammate Level Preservation Feature
After an upgrade, the levels of your teammates will be perpetually saved. The levels will not be cleared with game cycles.

6. Addition of 25 New Related Cards
Added 25 new cards that can be acquired throughout the course of battle.

II. Optimization

 Optimized the descriptive text of some cards;
 Optimized the triggering probability of events such as "Eris," "Evan," and "Encounter Guided by Stars";
 Optimized the activation logic of the Sacred Relic Atlas.
 Optimized and significantly reduced the difficulty for Recruit, Knight,and Lord.


III. Fixes

 Fixed the issue concerning the artifact "Philosopher's Stone";
 Fixed the intermittent disappearance of the camp exit button;
 Addressed the issue of card malfunction after fixed operations in Level 5-5;
 Corrected the display error in the card illustration manual upon initial game entry;
 Resolved the issue where achievements could not be synced with cloud saves;
 Fixed the problem of the card "Repeat" incorrectly affecting some cards for the second time;
 Rectified the issue with map layer display.
 Fixed issues with some achievements triggering abnormally;
 Solved the problem of teammates unlocked in Challenge Mode being recruitable in Story Mode.

notes.title: Development Plan for 'Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross' V1.0.04 Version
notes.notes:
Hi Fellows!

"Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross" has been officially launched on Steam for four days now, and we want to express our deep gratitude for the support and attention we've received from our knights! In this period, we've received numerous feedback and suggestions from our passionate knights. The production team has diligently discussed all collected feedback, and based on the current version's conditions, we have outlined our development plan.

We anticipate rolling out the upcoming version to our test server within this week. Additionally, we invite all our knights to assist us in testing and providing feedback. Once the version is confirmed stable, we will promptly update it to the official version. (please join Discord)

Please find the development plan as below:

1. Addition of the Relic Backpack, and Optimization of Sacred Relic Catalog Inclusion Logic
An additional feature, the 'Sacred Relic Backpack', will be introduced. Users can select whichever Sacred Relic they deem suitable to activate at any time. Furthermore, all Sacred Relics that are added to the backpack will also be included in the catalog.

2.I Inherit Ally Levels in Game Cycles
The levels of your allies will be preserved, just like the knight's level. They will not reset due to cycling through the game.

3. Addition of New Cards
In response to the current game mechanism, 24 new cards with various effects will be added to enrich diversity in deck building.

4. Addition of an Exclusive Store for Multiple Playthroughs
Targeting multiple playthroughs, once the side story with a team member is completed and the exclusive card and sacred relic have been obtained, an exclusive store will be unlocked. This store allows direct purchases once unlocked.

5. Open Level-up Stages
The refresh of leveling tasks will no longer require death, you can directly activate leveling tasks for training at the Camp NPC uncle.

6. Recall Feature for Recruited Teammates
Recall functionality will be activated for teammates who have previously been recruited and released. You can recall corresponding teammates at Mayael.

7. BUG Fixes and Prompt Optimization
We are swiftly addressing BUGs and content feedback from our knights. Before unlocking features, TIPS prompts will be added. (Details of the BUG fixes will be listed in update announcements afterwards)

notes.title: "Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross" V1.0.2 Version Rollback Announcement
notes.notes:
Hi Fellows!

Following the V1.0.2 version update, we have received numerous reports from players regarding irregularities in saved games and achievements. We deeply apologize for any negative experiences this may have caused. Upon receiving feedback, the development team immediately initiated urgent measures, working overtime to address these issues, and  has been rolled back to a version prior to V1.0.2..

For knights experiencing issues related to saved games and achievements, please join Discord and contact official customer service for assistance.

We would also like to request the understanding and forgiveness of all our knights. The production team will learn from this lesson, thoroughly examine each stage of the version release to avoid a similar situation from occurring again. We want to live up to the support and attention that you, our knights, have given to "Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross".

notes.title: Krzyżacy Gets a New Trailer and Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hi Fellows!

The wait is finally over! Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross’s latest trailer is finally here, and we are absolutely delighted to showcase our upcoming story-driven deckbuilding RPG in all its fantastic glory! 🎉

https://youtu.be/qKgZhoeYgQ0

We are also delighted to let you know that the game will be released on July 20 on Steam - we are about a couple of weeks from the premiere! 🙌

Featuring highly-detailed pixel art, epic historical stories, vicious bosses, hundreds of cards and relics, the game provides a special experience in this story-driven deckbuilding RPG with more than 30 unique teammates in the medieval 15th century. Unlike traditional deckbuilders, the teammates you recruit decide the success or failure of battles. Fight the war against the Teutonic, or tackle roguelite runs in this strategic deckbuilder unlike any other.
